query:
UPDATE legal_entities SET legal_name = $2, legal_form = $3, share_capital_minor = $4, address = $5,
                registration = $6, email = NULLIF(btrim($7), '')::citext, phone = NULLIF(btrim($8), ''),
                publication_director = NULLIF(btrim($9), ''), host = $10
         WHERE id = $1
